text: The paper reports that the ORM performs slightly better than majority voting while the PRM strongly outperforms both, reaching higher performance for all values of N with a gap that widens as N increases. Figure 3 on the same page gives best-of-1860 solve rates of 78.2% (PRM), 72.4% (ORM) and 69.6% (majority voting).
title: Large-scale PRM beats ORM and majority voting in best-of-N search on MATH
